en.headline: 48 Direct Subsidy Scheme schools approved for expansion, 170 non-local students enrolled
en.dek: The Education Bureau said the number of self-financed non-local students on student visas is up 13% this year, describing the pilot as off to a good start.
body: The Education Bureau said 48 Direct Subsidy Scheme schools have been approved to take part in the “DSS expansion” pilot, and that 170 non-local students holding student visas are enrolled this academic year on a self-financed basis, a 13% rise from last year.

In a column published on Wednesday, Deputy Secretary for Education Li Bik-chuen said seven more DSS schools are taking overseas students this year in addition to seven that did so in consecutive years. The students come from Thailand, South Korea, Singapore and various countries in Europe and North America, among others.

The Bureau is assisting the DSS Council in drawing up a code of practice for student boarding facilities covering standards, hygiene, safety and warden arrangements, and will help set up a committee to monitor compliance. The pilot adds extra places for non-local students without affecting local admissions, the Bureau said.

zh.headline: 48間直資學校獲批擴容 本學年170名非本地生入讀
zh.dek: 教育局指持學生簽證以自資模式入讀的非本地生較去年增13%，形容試點計劃開局良好。
body: 教育局表示，目前已有48間直資學校獲批參與「直資擴容」計劃，本學年持學生簽證、以自資模式入讀直資學校的非本地學生共有170人，較去年上升13%。
教育局副秘書長李碧茜周三在「局中人語」撰文指，除7所直資學校連續兩年取錄非本地生外，本學年再增7所取錄海外學生。學生來自泰國、韓國、新加坡以及歐美等多個國家。
教育局正協助直資議會制定《學生住宿設施營運實務守則》，涵蓋設施、衛生、安全及舍監安排，並會協助設立委員會審視執行情況。局方強調新增學額不會影響本地學生入讀機會。
